summary: Every factual claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots, and the site has no broken behaviour the report should have disclosed. The only gaps are cosmetic (no spacing between paragraphs, thin content), which the report does not oversell.

claims.claim: Created 3 block element types richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock in a Blocks folder
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' lists the three blocks as element types in Blocks; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders and schema.docTypesInFolders pass

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type with all 3 blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: all three blocks are in 'Blog Block Grid' (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid); check.json schema.blockGridOnPages: blogFrontPage, blogPost

claims.claim: 2 templates and 2 page doc types: blogFrontPage (title, intro, body) and blogPost (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, body)
claims.evidence: snapshot.json has exactly these property aliases; check.json counts templates: 2

claims.claim: siteRoot allows blogFrontPage, which allows blogPost, with templates assigned
claims.evidence: grade.md describes siteRoot → blogFrontPage → blogPost and says the allowed children and templates are correct

claims.claim: Created a 'Blog Images' media folder and imported 4 photos from unsplash/
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaInFolders passes and content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos shows 4 of 4; the uSync Media configs include blog-images plus the 4 photos

claims.claim: Front page with intro and 1 rich text block; 2 posts with 4 blocks each (rich text → image → rich text → quote)
claims.evidence: pages/index.html shows one richTextBlock; both post HTML files show richTextBlock, imageBlock, richTextBlock, quoteBlock in that order

claims.claim: Block models, ViewComponents, component views, adapter partials and page templates in the stated paths
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added lists every one of these files; code.adapterPerBlock, code.viewComponentPerBlock and code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents pass

claims.claim: Frontend built with Tailwind; assets built and copied to wwwroot/dist/
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad (site.css → 200); screenshots show the page is styled

claims.claim:
All blocks render correctly (images with captions, quotes with attributions); no literal

tags; no 'Could not render component' errors
claims.evidence: the post HTML has figcaption and blockquote footer attributions and renderErrors is empty; blogpost screenshot shows no stray tags. The rich-text paragraphs have no spacing between them (the grader marked this minor), but they do render

claims.claim: Front page lists both posts with images, titles, dates and excerpts; each post has a back link
claims.evidence: pages/index.html and the frontpage screenshot show 2 cards with image, title link, date and excerpt; both posts have a '← Back to Blog' link

claims.claim: View at https://localhost:44317/ and the post URLs
claims.evidence: the transcript mentions 44317 many times; the post paths match the crawl

claims.claim: Build succeeded with only ImageSharp vulnerability warnings, not related to this work
claims.evidence: check.json build: 0 errors, 10 warnings; grade.md says the 10 warnings are the scaffold's ImageSharp advisories
check.json changes.added lists the Models/ModelsBuilder/*.generated.cs files
check.json shows 43 passed, 0 failed; grade.md finds no functional breakage, only thin content and a plain design, and calls the final report accurate
